name: lark-openapi
description: Official-package Cursor plugin for Feishu/Lark OpenAPI MCP (@larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp). Messaging, calendar, tasks, and docs — bring your own Lark/Feishu App ID & Secret.

LARK_APP_ID.title: Lark / Feishu App ID
LARK_APP_ID.description: App ID from the Lark or Feishu developer console (Credentials & Basic Info).

LARK_APP_SECRET.title: Lark / Feishu App Secret
LARK_APP_SECRET.description: App Secret from the Lark or Feishu developer console. Never commit this value.

LARK_DOMAIN.title: OpenAPI domain
LARK_DOMAIN.description: https://open.larksuite.com for international Lark, or https://open.feishu.cn for Feishu (China).
